verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API (which includes the Invoicing API), and a probe confirmed the dedicated docs page at docs.stripe.com/mcp. The evidence shows the server exists but says little about how it is set up or what it can do for invoicing. Missing for 10: details on invoicing-specific MCP tools and actions, setup and auth documentation for connecting an agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
